purpose: Close the residual language created by repeatedly composing the v7.9 smooth twisted rigid wire only through full three-edge terminal-to-terminal Hamiltonian splices. Each terminal has exactly three dangling vertices; a full splice consumes all three against one neighbouring terminal. Therefore the wire-level interaction graph has maximum degree two and decomposes into paths and cycles. Compute the exact 18-state oriented step relations for all port matchings and wire orientations, close them under relational composition, and prove an exact polynomial solve/reconstruct terminal for this entire composition language.

local_state_space.wire_transfer: The v7.9 factor is the bijection F on Omega; reverse traversal uses F^{-1}.
local_state_space.splice_constraint: For a matching sigma, every p in {0,2,3} imposes colour(left,p) != colour(right,sigma(p)).

oriented_step_generators.definition: An oriented macro-step starts at one fully exposed terminal state, crosses one full three-edge splice into the next wire, then traverses that wire to its opposite terminal by F or F^{-1}. Include reversal of the resulting binary relation for traversal in the opposite macro direction.
oriented_step_generators.raw_count: 6 matchings x 2 choices F/F^{-1} x 2 directions
oriented_step_generators.meaning: These are the exact full-state generators; no orbit or gain projection is used in the closure.

finite_relational_semigroup.closure_operation: Ordinary existential relational composition on Omega. Closure is generated by appending or prepending any of the 24 oriented step relations.

cycle_holonomy_catalog.method: For a closed macro-cycle, compose its oriented step relations in traversal order. The cycle is satisfiable iff the resulting relation R contains at least one diagonal pair (x,x).
cycle_holonomy_catalog.global_symmetry_note: Fixed-state counts occur in multiples of six because simultaneous global colour permutation preserves the constraints.

structural_reason_for_tractability.terminal_capacity: A full splice consumes all three dangling Hamiltonian half-edges of a terminal C4 against exactly one partner terminal.
structural_reason_for_tractability.macro_degree: Each wire has two terminals, and each terminal can participate in at most one full splice. Hence every wire vertex has macro-degree at most two.
structural_reason_for_tractability.components: Every finite full-splice network is a disjoint union of paths and cycles at wire level.
structural_reason_for_tractability.no_branching_treewidth_growth: There is no high-degree factor graph in this restricted language; a constant-domain dynamic program along each path/cycle is exact.

algorithm.path: Choose one endpoint state among at most 18 possibilities and propagate reachable state sets through the ordered sequence of exact 18x18 relations. Equivalently compose relations. Runtime O(L*18^3) by direct Boolean relation multiplication, with constant 18; a precomputed 272-state multiplication table makes the online scan O(L).
algorithm.cycle: Compose the cycle relations and test the diagonal. The frozen 272-relation catalog makes this a constant-time terminal after a linear scan of the cycle word.
algorithm.reconstruction: Store one predecessor state for every reachable state at each step; backtrack from any accepted endpoint or diagonal state. Memory is O(18L) or O(18) with standard checkpoint/backtracking techniques.
algorithm.overall: Deterministic polynomial time, linear in the number of wires once the constant relation catalog is frozen.

main_theorem.name: FULL_THREE_EDGE_SPLICE_NETWORKS_OF_THE_V7_9_WIRE_ARE_EXACTLY_TRACTABLE
main_theorem.statement: Any finite network composed solely of v7.9 smooth twisted wires and full three-edge terminal-to-terminal splices, interpreted with the exact Omega-state semantics of v8.0, is decidable and witness-reconstructible in deterministic polynomial time. Its macrograph is a union of paths/cycles and all path summaries belong to a 272-element exact relational semigroup.
proof: Enumerate the six physical port matchings and combine each with both orientations of the rigid wire transfer and relation reversal, obtaining 24 distinct exact step generators.
Exhaust relational composition until fixed point. The checker obtains 24 -> 264 -> 272 -> 272 relations and freezes their exact cardinality distribution.

Full terminal consumption implies macro-degree at most two, so every connected instance is a path or cycle. Dynamic programming over 18 states is exact on either shape, independently of the precomputed semigroup bound.
For cycles, closing the walk is exactly a diagonal test in the composed 18x18 relation. For paths, reachable endpoint states and a witness are obtained by ordinary finite-state propagation.

positive: The gain branching discovered in v8.0 does not by itself create a hard core when every physical composition is a full three-edge terminal splice.
The entire repeated-full-splice language has a tiny exact finite summary algebra of 272 relations.
This is a genuine constructive polynomial terminal with exact witness reconstruction for a nontrivial source-inspired composition class.
killed: Seek NP-hardness or universal P-vs-NP leverage solely by chaining/cycling the v7.9 wire through full three-edge terminal splices.
Treat v8.0 set-valued gain branching as automatically implying exponential search.
Enumerate 18^n local states on a degree-two full-splice network.
firewall: This terminal does not cover partial one-edge/two-edge terminal splices, split terminal capacity across multiple neighbours, mixtures with the v7.7 rigid NEQ wire or v7.8 gain-only adapters, same-C4 Hamiltonian diagonals, or arbitrary smooth-C4 hard-source instances.

An arbitrary full-splice macro-network is not automatically proved completable to one global smooth Hamiltonian cycle; the algorithm solves the explicit factor/splice language whenever such a source realization is supplied.
This does not solve general 3-COLOR or SAT and does not imply P=NP.

next_target.name: E8_PARTIAL_SPLICE_BRANCHING_CORE_V8_2
next_target.directive: The next source of genuine macro branching must split terminal capacity. Enumerate one-edge and two-edge physical splices of the three-free-port v7.9 terminal, together with the remaining dangling ports, and derive the exact reusable boundary relations. Search first for a smallest component whose macro interaction degree exceeds two while all hidden ports can still be saturated and the kept Hamiltonian graph has no closed component. In parallel mix one v7.9 twisted wire with the nontrivial 46/50/52 gain-only v7.8 atoms. Any new hard-core claim must survive exact 18-state propagation and explicit Hamiltonian-port accounting.
